% defns TigrisTyping
%% defn Unify
\newcommand{\ottdruleUXXRefl}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \varnothing   \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{U\_Refl}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleUXXVarL}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \ottnt{tv}  \notin   \mathsf{ftv}( \ottnt{ty} )  }%
}{
 \ottnt{tv}  \mapsto  \ottnt{ty}   \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{U\_VarL}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleUXXVarR}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \ottnt{tv}  \notin   \mathsf{ftv}( \ottnt{ty} )  }%
}{
 \ottnt{tv}  \mapsto  \ottnt{ty}   \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{U\_VarR}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleUXXArrow}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{a}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{a'}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{\theta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottsym{[}  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{b}  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{b'}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
 \theta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \circ  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{a}  \to  \ottnt{b}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{a'}  \to  \ottnt{b'}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{U\_Arrow}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleUXXProd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{a}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{a'}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{\theta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottsym{[}  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{b}  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{b'}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
 \theta_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \circ  \theta_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{a}  \times  \ottnt{b}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{a'}  \times  \ottnt{b'}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{U\_Prod}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnUnify}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\theta  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}$}{\ottcom{Unification of types}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleUXXRefl{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleUXXVarL{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleUXXVarR{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleUXXArrow{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleUXXProd{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Solve
\newcommand{\ottdruleSlvXXEmpty}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottsym{(}   \varnothing   \ottsym{,}  \varnothing  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \varnothing  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Slv\_Empty}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSlvXXEq}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\theta  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{unify} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \theta'  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
\ottsym{(}   \theta'  \circ  \theta   \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}   \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \sim  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}} ,  \ottnt{C}   \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Slv\_Eq}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSlvXXPred}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \theta  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
\ottsym{(}  \theta  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottsym{pred,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}    \ottnt{pred} _ \ottmv{evidx}  ,  \ottnt{C}   \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Slv\_Pred}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnSolve}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottsym{(}  \theta  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{)}$}{\ottcom{Constraint solving}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSlvXXEmpty{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSlvXXEq{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSlvXXPred{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Instantiate
\newcommand{\ottdruleInstXXForall}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{tv'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh} \quad .. \quad \ottnt{tv'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{\theta  \ottsym{=}  \ottsym{\{}  \ottnt{tv_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \mapsto  \ottnt{tv'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{tv_{\ottmv{n}}}  \mapsto  \ottnt{tv'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}%
}{
\ottsym{(}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \bar{\pi}'  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{inst} \, \ottsym{(}  \forall \, \ottnt{tv_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, .. \, \ottnt{tv_{\ottmv{n}}}  .  \bar{\pi}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Inst\_Forall}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnInstantiate}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{inst} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{)}$}{\ottcom{Scheme instantiation}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleInstXXForall{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Generalize
\newcommand{\ottdruleGenXXGen}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\bar{\alpha}  \ottsym{=}   \ottsym{(}    \mathsf{ftv}( \ottnt{ty} )   \cup   \mathsf{ftv}( \bar{\pi} )    \ottsym{)}  \setminus   \mathsf{ftv}( \Gamma )  }%
}{
\ottsym{(}  \bar{\alpha}  .  \bar{\pi}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{gen} \, \ottsym{(}  \Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Gen\_Gen}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnGeneralize}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{gen} \, \ottsym{(}  \Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}$}{\ottcom{Generalization}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleGenXXGen{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn InferExpr
\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottmv{x}  :  \ottnt{sch} \, \in \, \Gamma}%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{inst} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottmv{x}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXInt}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%

\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXTrue}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%

\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXFalse}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{

\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXUnit}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%

\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXLam}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{ \Gamma ,  \ottmv{x}  :  \ottnt{tv}   \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash   \lambda\  \ottmv{x} .\  \ottnt{e}   \Rightarrow  \ottnt{tv}  \to  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Lam}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{a}  \ottsym{;}   \ottsym{(}   \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} ,  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{)} ,  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \sim  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \to  \ottnt{a} }{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_App}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXProd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \times  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}   \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} ,  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Prod}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXCond}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{3}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathbf{if} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \mathbf{then} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}} \, \mathbf{else} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{3}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}   \ottsym{(}   \ottsym{(}   \ottsym{(}   \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} ,  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{)} ,  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{3}}}}   \ottsym{)} ,  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \sim   \mathsf{Bool}    \ottsym{)} ,  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \sim  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{3}}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Cond}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXLet}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \theta  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{gen} \, \ottsym{(}  \Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{ \Gamma ,  \ottmv{x}  :  \ottnt{sch}   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathbf{let} \, \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \mathbf{in} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Let}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXFix}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{ \Gamma ,  \ottmv{f}  :  \ottnt{tv}   \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottkw{fix} \, \ottsym{(}   \lambda\  \ottmv{f} .\  \ottnt{e}   \ottsym{)}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}   \ottnt{C} ,  \ottnt{tv}  \sim  \ottnt{ty} }{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Fix}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXLetRec}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{ \Gamma ,  \ottmv{x}  :  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{tv}  \ottsym{)}   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \theta  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{solve} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{gen} \, \ottsym{(}  \Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}}%
\ottpremise{ \Gamma ,  \ottmv{x}  :  \ottnt{sch}   \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathbf{let} \, \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \mathbf{in} \, \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottsym{[}  \theta  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{C}}{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_LetRec}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleIXXAscribe}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}}%
\ottpremise{\ottsym{(}  \ottnt{ty'}  \ottsym{,}  \bar{\pi}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{inst} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{sch}  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e}  :  \ottnt{sch}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty'}  \ottsym{;}   \ottnt{C} ,  \ottnt{ty}  \sim  \ottnt{ty'} }{%
{\ottdrulename{I\_Ascribe}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnInferExpr}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \Rightarrow  \ottnt{ty}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}$}{\ottcom{Constraint-based inference}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXInt{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXString{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXTrue{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXFalse{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXUnit{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXLam{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXApp{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXProd{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXCond{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXLet{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXFix{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXLetRec{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleIXXAscribe{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn InferPat
\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXWild}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \_  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \varnothing  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_Wild}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottmv{x} \, \not\in \, \mathsf{dom} \, \ottsym{(}  \Gamma  \ottsym{)}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottmv{x}  \Rightarrow   \Gamma ,  \ottmv{x}  :  \ottnt{ty}   \ottsym{;}  \varnothing  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXConstInt}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottmv{intlit}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}  \sim   \mathsf{Int}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_ConstInt}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXConstStr}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottmv{strlit}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}  \sim   \mathsf{String}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_ConstStr}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXConstTrue}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottkw{true}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}  \sim   \mathsf{Bool}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_ConstTrue}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXConstFalse}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottkw{false}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}  \sim   \mathsf{Bool}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_ConstFalse}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXConstUnit}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottsym{()}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}  \sim   \mathsf{Unit}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_ConstUnit}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePXXProd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{a}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{b}  \ottsym{=} \, \mathsf{fresh}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{pat_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{a}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{pat_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{b}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{pat_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{pat_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{;}   \ottsym{(}   \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} ,  \ottnt{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{)} ,  \ottnt{ty}  \sim  \ottnt{a}  \times  \ottnt{b}   \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}}{%
{\ottdrulename{P\_Prod}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnInferPat}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{pat}  \Rightarrow  \Gamma'  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{C}  \ottsym{;}  \ottnt{ty}$}{\ottcom{Pattern inference}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXWild{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXConstInt{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXConstStr{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXConstTrue{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXConstFalse{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXConstUnit{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePXXProd{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnsTigrisTyping}{
\ottdefnUnify{}\ottdefnSolve{}\ottdefnInstantiate{}\ottdefnGeneralize{}\ottdefnInferExpr{}\ottdefnInferPat{}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnss}{
\ottdefnsTigrisTyping
}

\ottgrammar\\[5.0mm]
\ottdefnss}
